newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end off highs, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end off highs, seen rising.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended off the highs set at the opening and dealers said they could rise further tomorrow unless the U.S. market corrected.

"The market closed below the highs of the morning, but comfortable at these levels, and if there is no correction in the United States, we could see further rises, especially in longer bonds," an operator said.

Another operator said: "The spread between short and long bonds narrowed, as longer Portuguese bonds accompanied the foreign trend, while institutional investors showed little interest in shorter bonds."
